svg.text: Battery mechanical envelope - PowerXtra 1S Li-Po (dimensions INFERRED from part-number pattern, datasheet not found)
Side section (x-z), board length 80 mm, scale 9 px/mm
Bottom: 0.3 mm adhesive foam + cell 5.2 max + 0.5 mm swelling allowance = 6.0 mm below the PCB; top: 3.3 mm (USB-C 3.26, ESP32 3.2).
Assembly height ~ 3.3 + 1.6 + 6.0 = 10.9 mm (PX502050) or ~ 9.9 mm (PX402050), before enclosure walls. SMA edge connectors extend ~ +/-3.2 mm about the board plane (to be confirmed).
Section is a projection on x: the cell (y 19.5-40.0) does not overlap the USB-C legs (y 0-9.4). Cell edge x = 29.5 mm, i.e. 23.5 mm from the antenna strip (x 0-6); Espressif: >= 15 mm.
Plan view of the bottom (x-y), cell, leads, connector and retention
cell envelope 50.5 x 20.5 (L x W max, assumed)
Retention: 0.3 mm double-sided foam on the cell face + housing rib; no clips over the cell; dashed = 1 mm keep-free border for tolerance/swelling.
Leads: 2 wires from the cell's short edge to the board connector (lead length and connector type depend on the delivered cell: NOT verified).
Protection: a PCM is often fitted at the lead end and can add length; the 50.5 mm envelope may not include it - verify on the physical cell.
No bottom-side components inside the cell envelope; L4 under the cell: GND fill, no switching nodes (heat and coupling).
